removed_obligations.reason: platform v9 finding 2: a decimal tie (0.3 vs 3 x 0.1) is decided differently in binary and exact arithmetic; tie handling is not core (the task is about which amplitudes a station mean admits), so section 1 now keeps every amplitude a part in a thousand clear of three times its noise and no tie is graded

platform v9 finding 3: a hypocentral distance a hair beyond 600 km rounds onto 600 in doubles; the inclusive end is not core, so section 1 now keeps every station more than a metre from 10 and 600 km and no station on an end is graded

platform v10 finding 2: a single 1e-6 edge cannot be graded exactly against rounded expectations (v9 finding 4 was the opposite sliver); the instruction now passes numbers within 1e-6 and fails those more than 2e-6 away, leaving the band between open, and the verifier accepts 1.5e-6
